messages:
maria: quick follow-up on canary/ab fallback semantics. two tension points: fast emergency cutover (safety-first) vs gradual smoothing for experiments. want a single minimal protocol that supports both.

zhen: agree. emergency cutout needs to be immediate and authoritative. smoothing wants small, host-local adjustments. we should avoid the runtime guessing global intent.

leo: proposal: control-plane issues short-lived "cutout" leases for emergencies and longer "ramp" leases for experiments. runtime honors cutout immediately (stop new allocs), and applies ramp progressively with local smoothing.

olivia: love that. cutout lease fields: lease_id, variant_id, state=CUTOUT, issued_at, ttl, signer, reason. signed blob so runtime doesn't have to re-verify trust per message.

zhen: runtime behavior: on CUTOUT -> mark DRAINING, set drain_grace_ms (default 20s), stop new requests after drain window. on RAMP -> apply target_weight and ramp_duration_ms. smoothing algorithm = token-bucket per-variant host-side.

maria: need to bound hedges: runtime can still do immediate hedges for transient failures but must respect HedgeBudget tokens. HedgeBudget = rate_limit tokens renewed from control-plane and from local config. runtime must emit hedged_request_count metric.

leo: how do we report back that a cutout was successful? runtime should emit a reconciliation event: {lease_id, host_id, before_inflight, after_inflight, drained_at}. keep it compact (protobuf).

olivia: include a small ascii example in SDK docs for tracing:

```
trace.add_tag("lease_id", "L-20260401-42")
trace.add_tag("variant", "model-v3-q4")
trace.add_tag("fallback", "cutout")
```

zhen: race cases: if control-plane issues CUTOUT and also a RAMP for other variants, ensure revision numbers and timestamps determine ordering. runtime accepts messages with higher revision only. older messages are ignored.

leo: when a host restarts it should fetch active leases from the SSE stream and perform lease reconciliation. also a /leases/reconcile endpoint for immediate recovery.

maria: operator UX: console shows cutout with countdown TTL and an "escalate" button to convert to permanent eviction. also show hedging consumption per host.

olivia: security: sign leases with ed25519, include signer key id. control-plane rotates signing keys periodically; runtime must accept a small key-grace window.

zhen: metrics: runtime emits per-window probe summary: window_start, window_end, p50/p95, error_count, hedged_count. control-plane aggregates and can trigger cutout if thresholds met for N windows.

maria: action items: zhen drafts Lease proto + revision rules; leo drafts HedgeBudget token semantics and local token-bucket code sample; olivia updates SDK trace snippet & console mock; i'll write the RFC addendum showing sequence diagrams for CUTOUT vs RAMP.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "lease-types-cutout-ramp" enabled in staging @ 2026-04-06T12:40:00Z :rocket:

maria: thanks everyone. i'll collate and send a short addendum Monday. :thumbsup:
